@@U02376@@
Tame your wings, mind the accustomed reins! Master yourselves as I master you. When I urge you onward, surge away. But now we must honor these halls! Look around you, see the admiring crowd thronging forward, circle round circle! But come, Herald, do your duty. Describe us in your fashion, name us, before we take off. Being allegories, I suspect you should recognize us.

@@U02378@@
Name you? I couldn't possibly. I'd do better describing you.

@@U02380@@
Then do so.

@@U02382@@
I must confess, first, that you're young and you're handsome. A half-grown boy that the ladies will happily see fully grown one day. You appear a future ladies’ man, a born seducer.

@@U02384@@
Not bad! But continue.
translation:
@@U02376@@
驯服你的翅膀，注意习惯的缰绳！掌握你自己，就像我掌握你一样。当我催促你前进时，就冲走吧。但现在我们必须尊重这些大厅！看看周围，欣赏的人群蜂拥而至，一圈一圈！但是来吧，先驱报，履行你的职责。在我们起飞之前，以您的方式描述我们，命名我们。作为寓言，我想你应该认出我们。

@@U02378@@
说出你的名字？我不可能。我会更好地描述你。

@@U02380@@
然后就这样做。

@@U02382@@
首先，我必须承认，你很年轻，而且很英俊。一个半大的男孩，有一天，女士们会很高兴看到他完全长大。你看起来是一个未来的女士男人，一个天生的诱惑者。

@@U02384@@
还不错！但继续。
